_doc_files: One file = one effect (a file may also hold a list of effects). Files starting with '_' are ignored. Drop a new .json here, press the reload button in the menu (or refresh the browser): no Python/JS edits needed.
_doc_values: Any value can be: a literal (3, 'round', '#fff'); '$key' = value of a param; 'auto' = link type color; '=expr' = JS math expression. In expressions: $key (param), t (seconds), u (0..1 along the WHOLE route), v (0..1 along the current wire), s (px along the whole route), i (index), n (count), L (total route length), sin cos tan abs min max pow sqrt floor ceil round atan2 log exp PI, fract mix clamp rnd tri hsl(h,s,l,a) rgba(r,g,b,a) alpha(color,a).
